mapper.select: SELECT id, manufacturer_id AS manufacturerId, manufacturer_name AS manufacturerName, contact_person AS contactPerson, contact_phone AS contactPhone, email, address, license_no AS licenseNo, license_expiry AS licenseExpiry, status, remark, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM spd_manufacturer WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = #{delFlag}

SELECT id, manufacturer_id AS manufacturerId, manufacturer_name AS manufacturerName, contact_person AS contactPerson, contact_phone AS contactPhone, status FROM spd_manufacturer WHERE del_flag = #{delFlag} AND status = 1 ORDER BY manufacturer_name
